name: HH breakout 13 — opening-range break with range-position confluence (15m)
rationale: MECHANISM: the opening-range auction edge, but with an added CONFLUENCE requirement that range_position is ALSO at a genuine extreme when the ORB module fires — the distinct claim being that an opening-range break only pays when it coincides with a broader range high (a real structural extreme), not when the opening-range high sits in the middle of a wider trading range (a low-quality poke). Uses setup.orb (range_bars, buffer as fitted ParamRefs) AND a range_position floor entry condition, so both the session anchor and the structural extreme must align. atr is carried for context. bar_size 15m to catch the intraday break tightly. Distinct from variants 11/12 because the load-bearing extra filter is structural range confluence rather than participation or trend. DISCONFIRMER: KILL if the confluence adds nothing over the plain ORB (the range_position floor never binds because the ORB high is already the range high), OR if the anchor beats a random-hour placebo by nothing, OR if it survives only on illiquid alts where the 15m fills are fictional (spread wider than the move), OR if a 00:00 UTC placebo anchor matches it.
catalyst: opening-range break coinciding with a broader range extreme
